title: C SCHC lacks sender-side retransmission-attempt enforcement (R-03-042)
description: Spec-coverage 03-adaptation.md R-03-042: MAX_ACK_REQUESTS=4 sender attempts (initial All-1 + <=3 later, abort on exhaustion) is implemented+tested in Rust (fragment.rs) and Python (fragment.py + session_manager.py) but the C subsys has no sender fragmentation state machine at all. The only prior C evidence was the dead header macro SCHC_MAX_ACK_REQUESTS (removed from lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/include/lichen/schc.h as dead code in bead b7z9.92 fix, 2026-09-10); doc cell downgraded to 'C absent'. Receiver-side <=4-ACK bound exists at schc_session_control.c:241 (covers R-03-043). Needed: C sender-side attempt counting + abort-on-exhaustion, or an explicit C-subsystem scope decision.
